page.overview:
Who is Kabure Tokisuki?

Kabure has been said to like fashionable things and is weak-willed.

Kabure has short brown hair that comes to a point at the top. He has small black eyes and wears a blue forehead protector and the typical flak jacket of a Konoha shinobi.

Some time after Naruto Uzumaki saves the village from Pain, he asks Naruto to sign an autograph for his child.
